list.metaDescription: Benchmarking tasks on the OCI Platform. A model’s predictions are scored against ground truth held by the platform — the labels themselves are never published.
list.heading: Tasks
list.intro: These are benchmarking tasks. A model’s predictions are scored against ground truth held by the platform — the reference labels are never published, and no submission can read them. Only the resulting metrics come back.
list.cardDescription: Scores predictions against held-back labels for <link>{dataset}</link>.
list.methodsBody: Every result names the method and version that produced it. Each method declares what it defends against, who observes what, and the limits a submission runs within.
list.emptyBody: A task binds a catalogued dataset to a scoring configuration and a set of reference labels the platform keeps private. Once a host creates the first one, it will appear here.

detail.metaDescription: Scored submissions for the {slug} evaluation task. Metrics only — the reference labels are never published.
detail.lead: Predictions submitted for this task are scored against reference labels held by the platform. The labels are never published and are not part of any response — only the metrics below come back.
detail.aboutGrading: What is being scored, on which dataset, and where the referable cut-off sits.
detail.aboutClassification: What is being scored, on which dataset, and which labels a prediction may take.
detail.grades: <num>{count, plural, one {{n} class} other {{n} classes}}</num> <muted>(grade 0 to {top})</muted>
detail.threshold: <num>{threshold}</num> <muted>— referable means grade ≥ {threshold}; anything below that counts as non-referable.</muted>
detail.items: <num>{n}</num> <muted>— listed in full below; predictions are keyed on these identifiers.</muted>
detail.identifiersDescription: Every item this task scores against. A predictions file is a map keyed on these identifiers, and a sealed container receives the same set at run time as index.json on its /input mount. They are identifiers only — the reference labels behind them are held by the platform and are not part of any response.
detail.noItems: This task has no items yet.
detail.identifiersHint: Read this list rather than generating it — the identifiers are not guaranteed to be contiguous or densely numbered. Items you omit are permitted and reported as reduced coverage; identifiers this task does not recognise are a validation failure, so a mismatched naming convention fails loudly instead of scoring zero.
detail.perTaskTitle: Metrics are per task, not a global ranking
detail.perTaskBody: Each host brings a different clinical question, dataset and grading scale, so scores on this task cannot be compared with scores on any other task. There is deliberately no cross-task leaderboard (ADR-0017).
detail.resultsClassification: Ordered best first by macro F1 — the mean per-class F1 over the classes this evaluation set contains, so a model that ignores a rare class cannot hide behind a common one. Accuracy is shown alongside it because the two diverge exactly when the classes are imbalanced.
detail.resultsGrading: Ordered best first by QWK — quadratic-weighted kappa, the headline metric: agreement with the reference grades on a −1 to 1 scale where 1 is perfect and 0 is chance. The referable rates are measured against the grade ≥ {threshold} cut-off.
detail.resultsCoverage: Coverage is the share of the reference set a submission actually predicted. Results are provisional until the evaluation method that produced them is approved.
detail.noSubmissions: No submissions scored yet. Results appear here as soon as the first predictions file is submitted.
detail.statusNoteFailed: Scoring did not complete, so this submission has no metrics.

submitPage.metaDescription: Check and submit a predictions file for the {slug} evaluation task.
submitPage.heading: Submit predictions
submitPage.lead: Send one label per item and get the metrics back. The file is compared with reference labels the platform holds; those labels are never shown, to you or to anyone else.
submitPage.noItemsTitle: This task has no items yet
submitPage.noItemsBody: There is nothing to predict until its host adds them.
submitPage.step1Description: A spreadsheet file with one line for each of the {items} in this task, and an empty column for your labels.
submitPage.semicolon: If the file opens with everything in one column, your spreadsheet expects semicolons, as it does wherever decimals are written with a comma. Use the <link>semicolon-separated template</link> instead. Both are accepted.
submitPage.fillIn: In the label column, type a whole number from 0 to {top} for each item.
submitPage.fillGrading: The number is the grade; {threshold} or more counts as referable.
submitPage.fillClasses: Each number stands for one of the {n} classes.
submitPage.keepIds: Do not change the identifiers or the first line.
submitPage.leaveOut: To leave an item out, delete its line. It is then not scored, and the result shows lower coverage.
submitPage.saveCsv: Save the file as CSV, not as a spreadsheet workbook.
submitPage.step3Description: Checking is free and can be repeated as often as you like: it reads the file and tells you what to correct, without scoring it. Submitting for scoring is limited, so check first.
